missing_policy: PENDING/null means not published or not bound to matching evidence; never replace missing data with zero. Existing historical evidence must be reused after hash/scope checks.
itp_policy: One test execution and all its unresolved VCs form one ITP unit; display mean costs only. read uses 12 independently measured execution ITP tasks; legacy batch estimates are historical. Memory is a measured process peak and is never divided. ITP subtotal overlaps its component rows and must not be added again.

supplementary_costs.scope: All extra historical/source-revision/harness/native compatibility measurements, separate from final v3 and reused primary QCP costs; never add ITP subtotal to its component rows. Chat editing/orchestration tokens are not measured native model tokens.

test_modes.certificate: SMT decisions are NOT_CHECKED by Coq; matching historical refutations are separate evidence.

latest_execution_strategy_followup.expectation_policy: Per-case expected_by_execution_strategy; translation12 inline PASS, modular FAIL
